profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at Alarm.com

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Full-stack development and integration of home automation devices (thermostats, lights, locks, energy meters, water management, etc) across various protocols utilizing Android, .NET, MS SQL Server, and Ember.js
• Created and reviewed project design documents and led projects to completion
• Created and maintained technical, process, and cultural documentation
• (Previously) Directly managed a small team of software engineers

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Attend labs to assist students with in-class demos
• Assist students by debugging and testing assignments (Python, Java)
• Answer questions on the class discussion board (Blackboard, Piazza)
• Grade quizzes

positions.title: Repair Technician
positions.description:
• Diagnosed and repaired hardware and software issues on mobile devices and tablets
• Replaced components including display assemblies and batteries
• Provided customers with information, solutions, and accessories for their damaged devices

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
• Participated in the sale of basic electronics as well as mobile devices with carrier plans
• Performed stocking, cleaning, merchandising
